function.name: impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function is used to get the containing record of the given interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to get the containing record.

function.return_type: FileMonikerImpl pointer, which represents the containing record of the given interface pointer.

function.name: impl_from_IROTData
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a FileMonikerImpl structure that contains the IROTData interface passed as a parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IROTData interface

function.return_type: FileMonikerImpl pointer, represents a pointer to a FileMonikerImpl structure that contains the IROTData interface

function.name: unsafe_impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the vtable of the provided IMoniker interface matches the VT_FileMonikerImpl. If it does, it returns the containing record of the interface, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the implementation is to be extracted.

function.return_type: FileMonikerImpl*. It represents the implementation of the FileMoniker from the provided IMoniker interface. If the vtable does not match, it returns NULL.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a FileMoniker object. It checks if the requested interface is supported, and if so, returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the FileMoniker object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of the pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the FileMonikerImpl object

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the FileMonikerImpl object and decreases its reference count. If the reference count becomes zero, it releases the marshal and frees the memory allocated for the filePathName and the moniker itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to access the FileMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_GetClassID
function.description: This function checks if the pClassID pointer is null. If not, it assigns the value of CLSID_FileMoniker to the location pClassID points to.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used in the function

parameters.name: pClassID
parameters.description: Pointer to a CLSID variable. If not null, the function assigns the value of CLSID_FileMoniker to the location it points to.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if pClassID is null, otherwise returns S_OK.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if the file moniker is dirty or not.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the file moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_FALSE indicating that the file moniker is not dirty.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Load
function.description: This function reads data from a stream and loads it into a file moniker object. It handles memory allocation and error checking for the process.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the file moniker object

parameters.name: pStm
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream from which data is read

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds and an error code if it fails

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Save
function.description: This function saves a file moniker to a stream. It writes the file path and other constants to the stream. If the file path cannot be converted to the ANSI code page, or if it's a directory, or if there's a character > 0xFF, it writes the wide version of the file path.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the FileMonikerImpl object

parameters.name: pStm
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface on the stream where the file moniker is to be saved

parameters.name: fClearDirty
parameters.description: Indicates whether to clear the modified flag after the save is complete

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, E_POINTER if pStm is NULL, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or other error codes as defined by the IStream_Write function.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_GetSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates an over-estimate of the size of the file moniker object. If the pcbSize pointer is null, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the file moniker object

parameters.name: pcbSize
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the size of the file moniker object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pcbSize is NULL

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_BindToObject
function.description: This function binds to the object referenced by the moniker and returns the specified interface pointer to the caller.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the object that needs to be bound.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface on the bind context object.

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: If the moniker is part of a composite moniker, pointer to the moniker to the left of this moniker.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be used to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be E_FAIL or another error code.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_BindToStorage
function.description: This function binds a file moniker to a storage object. It checks the bind options and based on the parameters, it either opens the storage, returns an error, or does not implement the function.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the file moniker

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the current moniker

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Pointer to the object where the result is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be a success code, an error code, or a warning code.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Reduce
function.description: This function reduces the moniker to its simplest form for the specified bind context.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: howfar
parameters.description: Specifies how far the moniker should be reduced

parameters.name: toleft
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the IMoniker interface that will receive the remaining portion of the moniker after reduction

parameters.name: reduced
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the IMoniker interface that will receive the reduced moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns MK_S_REDUCED_TO_SELF if the function succeeds, or E_INVALIDARG if the input arguments are not valid

function.name: free_stringtable
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated for a string table.

parameters.name: stringTable
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the string table to be freed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_DecomposePath
function.description: This function decomposes a given path into its individual components and stores them in a string table. It also handles memory allocation for the string table and the individual strings within it.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the path that will be decomposed into its individual components.

parameters.name: stringTable
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a string table where the individual components of the path will be stored.

function.return_type: int, represents the number of components in the decomposed path. If an error occurs during memory allocation, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_ComposeWith
function.description: This function composes a new composite moniker by combining two existing monikers. It handles different types of monikers and performs various checks and operations to ensure the correct composition.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the first moniker to be composed.

parameters.name: pmkRight
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the second moniker to be composed.

parameters.name: fOnlyIfNotGeneric
parameters.description: Boolean flag that indicates whether the function should return an error if the moniker is not generic.

parameters.name: ppmkComposite
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the interface of the resulting composite moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It can return various error codes based on different conditions within the function.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Enum
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface is NULL. If it is, it returns an error code. Otherwise, it sets the pointer to NULL and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: fForward
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating the direction of enumeration

parameters.name: ppenumMoniker
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if ppenumMoniker is NULL, otherwise returns S_OK

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_IsEqual
function.description: This function checks if two file monikers are equal by comparing their filePathName properties.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: First file moniker to compare.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Second file moniker to compare.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents that the file monikers are equal, S_FALSE represents they are not equal, and E_INVALIDARG represents that the second file moniker is not provided.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Hash
function.description: This function calculates the hash value of a file path name stored in a FileMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to a FileMonikerImpl object

parameters.name: pdwHash
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD to store the calculated hash value

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pdwHash is NULL

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_IsRunning
function.description: This function checks if the specified file moniker is running or not. It first checks if the newly running moniker is equal to the interface, if not it gets the running object table from the bind context and checks if the interface is running in the object table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the file moniker to check if it's running

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context used to get the running object table

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Not used in this function

parameters.name: pmkNewlyRunning
parameters.description: Pointer to the newly running moniker, used to check if it's equal to the interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the moniker is running, E_POINTER if the bind context is NULL, or the result of the IRunningObjectTable_IsRunning function.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_GetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function retrieves the time of the last change to the file moniker object. It checks if the file moniker is registered in the running object table. If not, it retrieves the last write time of the file.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the file moniker object

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the current moniker in the composite

parameters.name: pFileTime
parameters.description: Pointer to the FILETIME structure that receives the time of the last change

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pFileTime is NULL, E_INVALIDARG if pmkToLeft is not NULL, or MK_E_NOOBJECT if the file does not exist

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Inverse
function.description: This function creates an inverse for a file moniker.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the moniker to be inversed

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the interface of the inverse moniker to be created

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_CommonPrefixWith
function.description: This function compares two file monikers and creates a new moniker that represents the common prefix of the input monikers. It also handles various edge cases and errors.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The first file moniker to compare.

parameters.name: pmkOther
parameters.description: The second file moniker to compare.

parameters.name: ppmkPrefix
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a moniker. If the function is successful, this parameter will point to the new moniker that represents the common prefix.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It can return various error codes in case of failure, such as E_POINTER, E_INVALIDARG, MK_E_NOPREFIX, and E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_RelativePathTo
function.description: This function creates a relative path from one file moniker to another.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the current file moniker.

parameters.name: pmOther
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the other file moniker.

parameters.name: ppmkRelPath
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a moniker that receives the relative path moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns E_POINTER if ppmkRelPath is NULL, E_INVALIDARG if pmOther is NULL, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to decompose the path, MK_S_HIM if the length of either path is 0 or both lengths are 1 and there are no similar items, and the result of CreateFileMoniker otherwise.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_GetDisplayName
function.description: This function retrieves the display name of a file moniker object. It checks for valid parameters, allocates memory for the display name, and copies the file path name to the display name.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the FileMoniker object

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of this moniker

parameters.name: ppszDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name string

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if ppszDisplayName is NULL, E_INVALIDARG if pmkToLeft is not NULL, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_ParseDisplayName
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is designed to parse a display name.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left

parameters.name: pszDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name string

parameters.name: pchEaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters parsed

parameters.name: ppmkOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_IsSystemMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the provided moniker is a system moniker and assigns the result to the pwdMksys pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pwdMksys
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD variable where the result is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pwdMksys is NULL

function.name: FileMonikerROTDataImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a FileMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IROTData interface of a FileMoniker object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which indicates the success or failure of the function.

function.name: FileMonikerROTDataImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to increase the reference count of a FileMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer used to access the FileMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count of the FileMonikerImpl object.

function.name: FileMonikerROTDataImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the FileMonikerImpl instance from the IROTData interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to represent the IROTData interface from which the FileMonikerImpl instance is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the FileMonikerImpl release operation.

function.name: FileMonikerROTDataImpl_GetComparisonData
function.description: This function gets comparison data for a File Moniker object. It copies the class identifier (CLSID) and the uppercase version of the file path name into the provided buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the File Moniker object

parameters.name: pbData
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the comparison data

parameters.name: cbMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of bytes that can be written to the buffer

parameters.name: pcbData
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the actual number of bytes written to the buffer

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function successfully writes the comparison data to the buffer, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if the buffer is not large enough to hold the data

function.name: FileMonikerImpl_Construct
function.description: This function constructs a FileMonikerImpl object. It initializes the virtual function table, allocates memory for the filePathName, decomposes the path, and modifies the filePathName based on certain conditions.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the FileMonikerImpl object to be constructed

parameters.name: lpszPathName
parameters.description: The path name to be assigned to the FileMonikerImpl object

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and S_OK if the function executes successfully

function.name: CreateFileMoniker
function.description: This function creates a FileMoniker object and initializes it with the specified path name.

parameters.name: lpszPathName
parameters.description: This is the path name used to initialize the FileMoniker object.

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IMoniker interface. If the function is successful, this parameter will contain the address of the pointer to the new FileMoniker object.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it can return one of the following values: E_POINTER, MK_E_SYNTAX, E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: memrpbrkW
function.description: This function scans a memory block for a set of characters in reverse order.

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory block to be scanned.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of characters to be scanned.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Pointer to the set of characters to be searched for.

function.return_type: WCHAR. Returns a pointer to the last occurrence of any character from the 'accept' set in the memory block. If no match is found, returns NULL.

function.name: FileMoniker_CreateFromDisplayName
function.description: This function creates a file moniker from a display name. It checks if the file is running, gets the full path name, and checks the file attributes. If the file is not running or the file attributes are invalid, it releases the file moniker and returns an error.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context interface

parameters.name: szDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name string

parameters.name: pchEaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters eaten in the display name

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the moniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory, MK_E_SYNTAX if there is a syntax error, or MK_E_CANTOPENFILE if the file cannot be opened.

function.name: FileMoniker_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a FileMoniker object, which is used to manage file-based monikers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IClassFactory interface that creates the object

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It could be a success or an error code
